items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: we became the greatest of friends, and I made some things for him

ctx.x: Yeah. Hillbilly and things like that -- but he was anxious to inject a little swing and have a little versatility in his band, and we became the greatest of friends, and I made some things for him, and I made some arrangements for Tiny on the standards, you know, and he told me, says, 'Jazz them up a little bit, not too much,' one of those things, you know.
